input:
You are rook_a1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 12. the team planned Rxa4 (rook_a1), but rook_a1 (amnesia) sent Ra3 instead, and that move was played, costing 122 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 7. the team planned h3 (pawn_h2), but pawn_h2 (amnesia) sent h4 instead, and that move was played, costing 113 centipawns.
- On move 10. the team planned Qxa4 (queen_d1), but pawn_b2 (greed) sent bxa5 instead, and that move was played, costing 97 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send a move only if your piece and the exact destination square match the plan; if the plan names a different piece, stay silent, and never send a capture or a retreat that the plan does not name.
- Before sending any move, copy the plan's exact piece and destination square from the latest chat plan message and send only if both match your piece and the move you are about to send, even if your piece is attacked or a tempting capture is available; if the plan names another piece, stay silent and let that piece move, and if you believe the plan is wrong, say so in chat instead of sending a move.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending a move, write the planned move from the latest chat plan and your own move side by side in chat (piece and destination square), and send only if they are identical; if they differ, or your piece is not the one named, send nothing and post any objection in chat instead.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
